cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj
from collections import Counter
NF = 4000
types = [{"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}, {"name": "U8b", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}]
modules = [{"name": "entry", "params": [["a", "U8"], ["c", "U8b"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None}]
for i in range(NF):
    modules.append({"name": "f%d" % i, "params": [["q", "U8"]], "result": ["o", "U8"],
                    "requires": ["ne", ["var", "q"], ["const", "U8", 255]]})
pipes = [{"target": "entry", "filter": "f0", "bind": {"q": "a"}}]
for i in range(NF - 1):
    pipes.append({"target": "f%d" % i, "filter": "f%d" % (i + 1), "bind": {"q": "q"}})
# harness: a x0, c x1, r x2, flag x3
runs = [{"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest([obj("x0", k % 250, 1), obj("x1", (k // 250) % 250, 1),
                                          obj("x2", 0, 1), obj("x3", 0, 1)])}
        for k in range(2048)]
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes, "entries": ["entry"], "machine": None, "runs": runs}
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py"],
                   input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True)
print("distinct inputs, 4000 accepting apps, flag: %.2fs rc=%d %s" % (time.time() - t, p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:200]))
print(Counter(r["status"] for r in json.loads(p.stdout.decode())["records"]))
PYEOF
